summary: Game crashes/freezes after creating/entering a Superflat world without presets
description: When create a superflat world without presets, it crashes. 1.16.2-pre2 Description: Ticking player java.lang.IllegalStateException: Unregistered biome at bw.b(SourceFile:88) at java.base/java.util.Optional.orElseThrow(Optional.java:385) at bw.a(SourceFile:88) at bw.a(SourceFile:68) at bx$a.a(SourceFile:55) at bx.a(SourceFile:31) at ck.a(SourceFile:62) at bx.a(SourceFile:31) at aah.v_(SourceFile:484) at aay.b(SourceFile:207) at nd.a(SourceFile:234) at aax.c(SourceFile:173) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.b(SourceFile:881) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.a(SourceFile:810) at emy.a(SourceFile:92) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.w(SourceFile:669) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.a(SourceFile:254) at java.base/java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:844) 1.16.2-pre3 [18:07:58] [Render thread/WARN]: Received invalid biome id: -1
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft Java Edition 1.16.2-pre2.
2. Create a new Singleplayer world.
3. Select the "Superflat" world type without selecting any presets.
4. Create the world and enter it.
5. Wait for the game to process the world generation.
6. Observe that the game crashes or freezes after entering the Superflat world.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 1.16.2 Pre-release 2, 1.16.2 Pre-release 3
Observed Behavior: When creating or entering a Superflat world without presets in Minecraft version 1.16.2-pre2, the game crashes due to an unregistered biome error, specifically resulting in a java.lang.IllegalStateException. The crash occurs during the ticking player process, as indicated by the stack trace that points to various methods within the game's biome handling code. This issue persists into version 1.16.2-pre3, where a warning is logged about an invalid biome ID of -1, further confirming the underlying problem with biome registration in Superflat worlds created without specified presets. This behavior leads to an immediate crash, preventing players from successfully entering or interacting with the generated world. Developers should investigate the biome registration process for Superflat worlds, particularly focusing on scenarios where no presets are applied, to resolve this critical issue.
Expected Behavior: When creating a Superflat world without presets, the game should successfully generate the world without crashing or freezing. Players should be able to enter the Superflat world and explore it without encountering any errors related to biome registration or invalid biome IDs. This expected behavior should be consistent across versions, including 1.16.2-pre2 and 1.16.2-pre3, allowing for a seamless gameplay experience.
